title: WP-M2-02 schema parity audit found 972 diffs
summary: The first authoritative schema parity audit is not clean: 0/40 deals pass, with 972 total diffs. Main categories: 480 schema card short-title mismatches, mostly [PROPOSED] labels visible in schema cards while legacy user-mode strips them; 285 type mismatches, including STRUCT provisions mapped to MISC_BOILERPLATE by the card writer; 145 visible legacy provisions missing schema cards, usually M2-00 backfill coverage gaps; 62 schema-only cards, often uncovered-text coverage cards that legacy user-mode does not render. Do not delete the legacy renderer or vocab sources until these are remediated and the audit returns zero diffs.

choices.label: Approve remediation plan
choices.codex_action: open follow-up mechanical PRs to strip proposed labels from schema user-mode cards, fix STRUCT/OTHER card type mapping, exclude coverage-plumbing cards from user-mode schema render, repair missing-card backfill coverage, rerun the parity audit, and resume WP-M2-02 only once zero diffs are reached

choices.label: Investigate before remediation
choices.codex_action: produce deeper per-category samples and proposed code changes before touching card writer or renderer logic

choices.label: Defer parity cleanup
choices.codex_action: leave WP-M2-02 gated and do not proceed to M2-04 or M2-05 destructive cleanup
